## ModelRouteService

Manages chalk/* aliases mapping a public model id to a connection + upstream  model id. connection_id is a soft reference (no FK); resolution status is  reported per route as a diagnostic.

## HeuristicJudgeBackend

Difficulty-only classifier: any enabled hard signal selects outcome "1";  otherwise selects outcome "0".

| Field (ProtoJSON name) | Tag | Type | Presence | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `use_default_keywords` (`useDefaultKeywords`) | 1 | `bool` | optional | Defaults to true when omitted. |
| `added_hard_keywords` (`addedHardKeywords`) | 2 | `string` | repeated | Case-insensitive substring matches against user-message text.  A keyword cannot appear in both the added and removed lists. |
| `removed_hard_keywords` (`removedHardKeywords`) | 3 | `string` | repeated | Removes entries from the default keyword set, case-insensitively. |
| `code_blocks_are_hard` (`codeBlocksAreHard`) | 4 | `bool` | optional | Treat triple-backtick code fences in any message role as hard.  Defaults to true when omitted. |
| `max_easy_input_bytes` (`maxEasyInputBytes`) | 5 | `uint32` | optional | Total text across message roles exceeding this UTF-8 byte count is hard.  Defaults to 6000 bytes when omitted; zero disables the length signal. |
